title: RefSiblingValues2020
description: The other side of the draft split, and the control on the change #151 makes: from 2019-09 on a $ref is an ordinary applicator and the sibling does apply, so every rejection here has to survive a fix that removes those same rejections one draft earlier. The word `false` is admitted by the target and refused by each sibling, and that refusal is the whole of what this fixture watches.
